lines.zh: 我背着壳，横着走过沙地。
lines.en: I cross the sand sideways with my shell on my back.
The shell is heavy and I move slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着潮线走，找能吃的。
lines.en: I walk the tide line, looking for something to eat.

lines.zh: 我用一只钳子撑着地往前。
lines.en: I push forward with one claw on the ground.

lines.zh: 沙子上留下一串斜的脚印。
lines.en: My tracks trail at an angle across the sand.
I come around the far side of the dune.
My shell scrapes the stone with a squeak.

lines.zh: 我跟着水退下去的方向走。
lines.en: I follow the direction the water pulled back.
I stop to swap shells, then carry on.
I turn sideways to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我走一段，就缩进壳里听听。
lines.en: I walk a while, then tuck in to listen.
The sand is hot, so I hurry.

lines.zh: 我缩在壳里，只露出一只眼。
lines.en: I tuck in, showing one eye.
Wind blows sand into my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 我在沙里挖了个浅坑，趴着。
lines.en: I've dug a shallow pit and lie in it.
This shell is getting a bit tight.

lines.zh: 潮水刚退，岸边还有味道。
lines.en: The tide just went out; the shore still smells of it.
I raise a claw, then lower it.

lines.zh: 有什么东西从我上面走过。
lines.en: Something walked right over me.
I press my shell a little deeper into the sand.
The sun has made my shell hot.

lines.zh: 沙地上的螺壳，我住得惯。
lines.en: I am at home in a snail shell on the sand.
A small bug is by my claw.
I slowly turn my eyestalk.
Wet sand seeps in through the shell gap.
I tidy the rim of my shell with a claw.

lines.zh: 你的脚挡住我回洞的路。
lines.en: Your foot is blocking my way to the burrow.
I lift my head, eyestalks out.

lines.zh: 这么大的家伙，我第一次见。
lines.en: You're the biggest thing I've seen.
Are you going to take my shell?
I tuck in first, then peek.
Your foot is bigger than my shell.
I shuffle sideways half a step.
You're not here for shells, are you?

lines.zh: 我听见你踩沙子的声音。
lines.en: I hear your feet in the sand.
The sun is behind you.

lines.zh: 我的钳子不算大，也会夹。
lines.en: My claws aren't big, and they do pinch.
Crouch down and I won't run.
I know this beach well.
What you're holding is wet.
I back away toward the water.
Don't turn me over.

lines.zh: 我壳上还带着上一位房客。
lines.en: There's still a previous tenant on my shell.

lines.zh: 你的影子给了我一点凉。
lines.en: Your shadow gives me a little cool.
I tuck into the shell and go quiet.
There's a new mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 我露出的肚子沾满细沙。
lines.en: My exposed belly is coated in fine sand.
I thrash until I'm upright.
That hit leaves me trembling.
Carrying a sand shell, I move slowly.
My borrowed shell is chipped at one corner.
I'll hide first.
Sand covers half of me.
I can still shuffle two steps.
I can carry that.
My claw is reaching out.
It's a small soft bit.
I pick up a scrap of seaweed.
There's still a little left in that shell.
Dragging it, I can't go fast.
Put it down; I'll take it myself.
This smells better than my shell.
Once I pinch it, I won't let go.
A little more — just a little.

lines.zh: 壳太沉，我只能横着慢慢挪。
lines.en: This shell is heavy; I can only sidle slowly.
I've been shoved entirely.

lines.zh: 我从壳里弹出半个身子。
lines.en: Half of me pops out of the shell.
You stepped on my claw.
I shuffle sideways away.
Sand has got into my shell.
That wasn't a hard bump.
I've set my shell straight again.
Don't touch my shell; it's home.
I pinched you — sorry.

lines.zh: 另一只壳从沙下面冒出来。
lines.en: Another shell surfaces from under the sand.

lines.zh: 我们并排横着走，沙里好藏。
lines.en: Let us walk sideways together; the sand hides us.
We walk sideways, shell knocking shell.
She taps back, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我们在潮水里换了位置。
lines.en: We trade places in the tide.
She nudges my shell an inch.
This has to be done near the water.
Afterward we each find our own shells.
She's a little bigger than me.
We've both tucked in.
I pinch it and turn away.
It takes both claws to hold it steady.
This could cover my back.
Too heavy; I drag it.
I prop it on my shell.
It's empty — a perfect swap.
I held it a while, then dropped it.

lines.zh: 我把它推进沙里藏起来。
lines.en: I push it into the sand to hide it.
This shell is too small; never mind.

lines.zh: 我钻进空贝壳里，只露腿。
lines.en: I tuck into an empty shell, legs out.
There's something moving over there.
It's bigger than me; let me look first.
I've raised my claws.
It's on my patch of sand.
Locked on; I move in sideways.
Is it after my shell?
I tuck half in, then come back out.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，沙子盖着壳。
lines.en: It has not seen me, sand covers my shell.
I'm circling around the side.
I have to keep this shell.
I'm ready to pinch.
It stepped on my burrow.

lines.zh: 我这只小寄居蟹，壳是捡的。
lines.en: A small hermit, my shell was found.
I pinch and go.
I dig my hole deeper in the sand.
I turn broadside to block the way.
I crawl low across the sand.
I stop at its feet.
I test how thick it is.
Too hard; I try another side.
I turn my eye stalks toward it.
I wait for it to stop moving.
The tide is coming in.
I've got a small bit.
It shakes me and I pinch harder.
I withdraw into the shell to think.
This time I come from below.
Sand is in my eyes.
I gauge where its joint is.
It only cares about reaching the water.
I creep sideways across the wet sand.
This pinch goes for the joint.
It lowered its head — good.
I'm waiting for the tide to pull back.
I pinch its toe.
I twist, and it jumps.
I ram it with my shell.
It flung me off.
I slide sideways for a stretch.
The claw snaps shut with a click.
I got a clawful of sand.

lines.zh: 钳口一下合死它的脚趾。
lines.en: My pincer shuts hard on its toe.
I tuck in to dodge.
I reach out again.
That pinch went deep.
Both claws at once.
It retreated; I follow two steps.
The sand is full of my tracks.
I clamp its ankle and hold.
My shell thuds against its leg.

lines.zh: 沙滩的寄居蟹，壳是捡的。
lines.en: Beach hermit crab. Found shell.
The shell comes out first, then me.
The tide just went out; I pick this spot.
I'm dragging a new shell.
Wind blows sand onto my shell.

lines.zh: 我顶着一个捡来的螺壳。
lines.en: I carry a found whelk shell on my back.
The sand here is fine; easy to dig.
I take two steps sideways.
The sun is too bright for me to open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从旧壳里探出半截身子。
lines.en: I poke half my body out of the old shell.
There's a line of tide marks on the shore.
I need to find a shell quickly.
I stop at the tide line.

lines.zh: 这枚壳是从水里拖来的。
lines.en: This shell was dragged out of the water.
First I dig the burrow.
Sand slides off me.
I measure this ground sideways.

lines.zh: 潮线边上留下我的横痕。
lines.en: My sideways track is left along the tide line.

lines.zh: 沙子烫得像锅底，我的壳在响。
lines.en: The sand is hot as a pan and my shell ticks.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下来，壳磕坏了。
lines.en: I roll down the dune and my shell chips.

lines.zh: 水把我吞了，我拼命往沙里钻。
lines.en: Water swallows me and I dig frantically.
The blast buries me in sand.
An arrow hits my shell square on.
That light leaves me unable to move.
I'm too hungry to drag my shell.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙滩上，我的壳在颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the beach and my shell rattles.
The sand is gone and I fall into nothing.
